The '''Hanger Market''' was a marketplace located in [[Foamwander City]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] was almost entirely made up of [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] which all led to the marketplace. At the Hangar Market, most commerce was conducted by [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and traders who sold their goods in bulk. It was considered rude at the market to [[Currency/Legends|pay]] full price for goods without negotiating first.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hanger Market was mentioned in ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', a [[2015]] sourcebook for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]'s [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
